messages:
liz: quick sync  new idea for the roles matrix: move from full-width rows to compact cards so teams can scan more roles at once. mock in figma. wondering tradeoffs for actions (invite / enforce sso / audit).
raj: compact cards sound great for orgs with many roles. what's the plan for actions? inline buttons likely reduce discoverability.
liz: thought was: visible primary action (Invite), then a secondary overflow for SSO + audit link on hover/keyboard. Desktop shows actions, mobile collapses to kebab.
noah: concern: overflow menus break discoverability and keyboard flow. if SSO enforcement is hidden behind kebab, power users may miss it. Also screenreader announcement for menu items can be noisy.
maya: +1 to keeping SSO visible for admin-level roles at least. maybe show an explicit small label chip "SSO" when enforced, and clicking the chip opens the confirmation dialog.
emma: accessibility nits: chips need proper aria-pressed state and focus outline. also ensure chip text contrast meets 4.5:1.
a11y-bot: automated checks from prototype:
- role-card chip text contrast: 3.2:1 (fail)
- overflow menu items missing role attributes for keyboard: need role="menuitem"
- dialog lacks aria-describedby linking to list of affected users

liz: good catch. we can update chip styles and add aria-describedby to dialog. Copy question: modal heading "Enforce SSO for Role" vs "Require SSO for this role"? which is clearer?
raj: "Enforce SSO for Role" reads a bit clunky. maybe "Require SSO for [Role name]" with role in bold? keeps it contextual.
noah: prefer active voice: "Require single sign-on for Admins". Also modal should include quick links: [View affected users] and [Audit log entry], the latter should open filtered view in the audit log and highlight the created event.
maya: about audit navigation: can we deep-link to audit entries? product: we need an anchor that includes role_id, action=ssotoggle, timestamp, so the audit page can auto-scroll to entry and open details.
emma: must ensure those deep-links respect RBAC (only show to users with audit view perms). fallback should show filtered results with a toast if the specific entry isn't visible.
a11y-bot: audit page deep-link accessibility notes: ensure focus lands on the opened audit item, and that screenreader announces "Audit item opened".
liz: implementation sketch for modal button actions:
```
- Primary: Confirm (Require SSO)
- Secondary: Cancel
- Link: View affected users (opens side panel)
- Link: View in audit log (opens audit page, deep-link)
```
raj: also UX copy tiny change: button label Confirm vs Turn on SSO. which is less scary? "Turn on SSO" is explicit but long. "Enable SSO" is shorter.
noah: maybe keep explicit on primary: "Enable SSO for Admins" and add secondary danger text below: "This will block sign-in for X users until they set up SSO."
maya: for bulk operations from matrix (select multiple roles and enable SSO), modal should summarize roles and give per-role affected user counts. we need to surface approximate counts quickly to avoid accidental lockouts.
emma: accessibility: bulk modal needs proper headings per region, checkbox to confirm understanding, and keyboard accessible table for affected users.
a11y-bot: run checklist post-proto: focus trap, aria-describedby, role attributes for menu and chip, contrast fix, announce toast for deep-link fallback.
liz: action items: 1) design to update compact card with visible SSO chip and overflow for less-used actions (i'll post by tomorrow). 2) eng to spec deep-link format for audit entries (maya + noah). 3) product to finalize modal copy and bulk flow (raj). 4) a11y run after prototype (emma + a11y-bot).
raj: +1 for deep links. one more: audit log should have a keyboard shortcut to jump to last SSO toggle events (maybe "/" search then type). low priority.
oah: small dev note: chips should be implemented as buttons (<button aria-pressed>) not span to be keyboard tabbable without extra handlers.
emma: +1 on button semantic. also make sure tooltips appear on focus.
maya: schedule: can we get a prototype by end of next week for usability testing?
liz: yes will aim for that. i'll tag this thread when figma is updated. thanks everyone :rocket:
